resources.string: Counts Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

Reel Counter uses Accessibility to see which Instagram or YouTube screen is showing, so it can count each Reel and Short you watch and block them when you reach your limit. It reads on-screen labels only in memory to tell reels apart, and never stores or sends captions, usernames, messages or anything from other apps.
Heads-ups at 50%, 80% and 100% of your daily limit
Tells you if counting stops, with a one-tap fix
